description: Abstract class defining common database operations for MySQL, including insert, delete, update, search, and count, utilizing query builder classes and handling pagination and search criteria.

classes.name: MysqlRepository
classes.description: Abstract class providing MySQL database operations such as insert, delete, update, search, and count, with support for query building, pagination, and search criteria.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger instance for logging purposes.

methods.name: executeInsertStatement
methods.description: Executes an insert statement and returns the new record ID.

methods.name: generateParamTypes
methods.description: Generates parameter types string for prepared statements based on column names.

methods.name: deleteByTableId
methods.description: Deletes a record by table name and ID.

methods.name: deleteByTableIds
methods.description: Deletes multiple records by table name and list of IDs.

methods.name: updateByTableId
methods.description: Updates a record by table name and ID with new column values.

methods.name: searchAll
methods.description: Performs a search query with optional pagination and ordering, returning all matching records.

methods.name: countSearchResults
methods.description: Counts the number of search results matching criteria.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to get the base select query builder; unimplemented in this class.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts total records matching search criteria.
